note: Ghana: a foreign national lawfully admitted who wishes to work and reside applies to the Comptroller-General of Immigration for a work and residence permit, with the contract of employment and a supporting ministry's letter among the requirements. ECOWAS citizens' position isn't modelled apart. No days without the permit.

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service, Work and Residence Permit (Companies)
sources.said: A foreign national who has been lawfully admitted entry into Ghana and wishes to work and reside in the country may submit an application letter for a Work and Residence permit addressed to the Comptroller-General of Immigration.
